title: The 5 Animals That Kill the Most People, Ranked (Sharks Don't Make the List)

scenes.text: The five animals that kill the most people every year, ranked. Sharks don't even make the list.

scenes.label: Crocodiles · ~1,000 a year
scenes.text: Number five: crocodiles. About a thousand people a year, most of them along rivers in Africa.

scenes.label: Dogs · 59,000 a year
scenes.text: Number four: dogs. Fifty-nine thousand people a year, almost all of them from rabies.

scenes.label: Snakes · ~100,000 a year
scenes.text: Number three: snakes. Around one hundred thousand people a year, mostly where antivenom is hours away.

scenes.label: Humans · ~440,000 a year
scenes.text: Number two: humans. Around four hundred and forty thousand homicides a year, worldwide.

scenes.label: Mosquitoes · 700,000+ a year
scenes.text: Number one: the mosquito. More than seven hundred thousand people a year, through malaria, dengue and the diseases it carries.

description:
The five animals that kill the most people each year, ranked by deaths per year.
Sharks kill about five to ten people a year. Crocodiles about a thousand. Dogs 59,000. Snakes around 100,000. Humans around 440,000. Mosquitoes more than 700,000.
Did you expect number two?
first_comment: Did you expect number two? Which animal should we rank next: strongest bite, loudest, or biggest?
